name: BottomSheetTokens
summary: A bottom sheet: a surface that rises from the bottom edge.
variantEnumSummary: Modal sheets float above the content behind a scrim; standard ones sit within it.

ScrimColor.summary: The dimming behind a modal sheet.

DragHandleColor.summary: The handle at the top of the sheet.

ContainerShape.summary: The sheet corners — rounded only along the top edge.

DragHandleSpace.summary: The room above and below the handle.

MaxWidth.summary: How wide the sheet gets on a large window before it stops filling it.

ScrimOpacity.summary: How far the scrim dims what is behind.

IsModal.summary: Whether the sheet floats over the content behind a scrim.
